Overview.Name: M N P V Kishore
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include eggs as main protein

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (3 eggs) pan fried & vegetable dosa (1)
Option 2: Idli (2) & sambar (1 cup) & paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 3: Puffed rice (2 cups) & 2 boiled eggs
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & dal (1 bowl) & spinach curry
Option 3: 2 chapati & paneer curry (80 g paneer) & salad
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & paneer cubes (60 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Since diabetes is present, keep rice portions smaller and make eggs or paneer the main part of meals.
Sweet cravings can be managed by eating fruit or buttermilk before choosing desserts during gatherings.
Because appearance is a strong motivation, keep protein portions consistent to improve body composition.
Field work requires steady energy, so avoid skipping meals even on busy days.
Simple pan fried egg dishes will help you stay consistent without complicated cooking.
